name: Riyal’s Mental Guard
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 1, cleric 1, inquisitor 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 minute/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The subject’s mind becomes hardened. The spell grants a +2 resistance bonus to all saving throws against mind-affecting spells and effects. The bonus from this spell does not stack with other resistance bonuses.
